errors.text_span: Der Wertebereich der y-Achse reicht von -8 zu 6
errors.evidence: The visible range of the y-axis in the figure is from -7 to 3, not -8 to 6.
The line plot does not use any markers; it is a solid, continuous line. The mention of 'small triangle markers' is a hallucination.

errors.text_span: Die Linie beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 1 Euro/MWh im April 2024
errors.evidence: The line starts at a value of approximately 2 Euro/MWh in April 2024, not 1 Euro/MWh.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis Juni 2024 um etwa 1,8 Euro/MWh abfällt
errors.evidence: The line does not drop by 1.8 Euro/MWh by June 2024. It fluctuates between approximately 1 and 2 Euro/MWh during this period. A drop of 1.8 would bring the value close to 0, which is incorrect.

errors.text_span: verliert dann an Wert bis September 2024 auf unter 1 Euro/MWh
errors.evidence: The line value in September 2024 is still above 1 Euro/MWh. It drops below 1 Euro/MWh around October 2024.

In December 2024, the value of the line is between approximately -0.5 and -3 Euro/MWh. It does not reach -6 Euro/MWh. The lowest point of the graph (around -6.5) is reached in late January/early February 2025.

errors.text_span: bevor sie bis Februar 2025 auf 5 Euro/MWh ansteigt
errors.evidence: The line does not rise to 5 Euro/MWh. The final value at the end of the period shown in February 2025 is approximately -2 Euro/MWh.
